results.hypothesis: The feature activates on copular/modal phrases like "it may be useful" or "it is convenient" that evaluate an action as useful, convenient, or easier.
positive_probes: It may be useful to restart the router.
It is convenient to save your work early.
It might be easier to call ahead first.
It would be helpful to back up everything.
It is useful to label each container clearly.
distractor_probes: The toolbox is useful for small repairs.

Convenient stores stayed open all night.
